articles.title: Real world clinical outcomes of deep learning based versus manual proton therapy planning for oropharyngeal cancer: A matched cohort study
articles.summary: This study evaluated real-world outcomes for oropharyngeal cancer patients receiving deep learning-based intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) versus manual planning. The findings indicate no significant difference in oncological outcomes or side effects, supporting the clinical integration of automated planning workflows.

articles.title: Mapping the evolution of spatially fractionated radiation therapy: A comprehensive bibliometric analysis of research trends and future directions
articles.summary: This bibliometric analysis tracks the convergence of various spatially fractionated radiation therapy (SFRT) modalities into a unified field. It highlights critical research priorities, including standardizing clinical protocols and integrating emerging FLASH radiotherapy techniques.

articles.title: Gaussian process regression of HDR prostate biopsy dose for improved modelling of localization-induced uncertainty
articles.summary: This study proposes a Gaussian process regression framework to model localization-induced uncertainty in HDR prostate brachytherapy. The authors demonstrate that a spatially correlated model provides superior dose representation compared to voxelwise summaries, offering a practical tool for probabilistic quality assurance and dose-response analysis.

articles.title: Treatment plan quality comparison between ZAP-Axon( ) Krylov optimizer and Leksell Gamma Knife( ) Lightning optimizer for brain metastasis
articles.summary: This comparative study evaluates the plan quality of the ZAP-Axon Krylov optimizer against the Leksell Gamma Knife Lightning optimizer. Findings suggest that the Krylov optimizer performs comparably for large brain metastasis lesions and outperforms the Lightning optimizer for small lesions in the absence of manual adjustments.

articles.title: A multicenter, prospective, phase 2 trial on proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer
articles.summary: This phase 2 trial evaluates the effectiveness and safety of proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer. While the study demonstrates encouraging locoregional control and survival, it highlights the importance of monitoring late toxicities in heavily pretreated populations.

articles.title: AAPM Medical Physics Practice Guideline 18.a: Superficial radiation therapy using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays
articles.summary: This guideline provides a comprehensive technical overview and framework for the clinical delivery of superficial radiation therapy (SRT) in the 50-100 kVp range. It is designed to assist medical physicists and clinicians in adhering to minimum safety and quality standards for treating non-melanoma skin cancer and benign conditions.

articles.title: A Large Language Model Framework for Seed Implant Brachytherapy: Adaptive Weight Optimization via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.summary: This study introduces an adaptive framework using a locally deployed large language model to optimize objective function weights in seed implant brachytherapy. The integration of LLMs with automated planning algorithms aims to improve clinical planning efficiency and plan quality.

articles.title: Generalized multi-energy model for computing radiation treatment parameters
articles.summary: This study presents a general n-energy mathematical model for predicting relative electron density, effective atomic number, and stopping power ratio from CT images. It offers a standardized algorithm for model selection, incorporating existing methods as special cases for improved treatment planning.

articles.title: Automated verification of source dwell position in lunar ovoid applicators
articles.summary: This research introduces a methodology to improve source path verification for complex brachytherapy applicators. The approach aims to reduce manual intervention and geometric uncertainties in clinical treatment planning and quality assurance.

articles.title: In Vitro Alpha Particle Irradiation: Methodological Determinants of Experimental Reliability
articles.summary: This study establishes a reproducible methodological framework for conducting in vitro alpha particle irradiation experiments. By identifying key determinants of experimental reliability, the authors provide a practical platform for future research into the biological mechanisms of alpha particle radiation.

articles.title: Analysis on radiation protection of FLASH treatment in conventional proton therapy facilities
articles.summary: This study assesses radiation safety for FLASH proton therapy in existing clinical settings using a Varian ProBeam system. The authors conclude that environmental and occupational dose limits remain safe and controllable under current shielding configurations, supporting the clinical implementation of FLASH technology.

articles.title: A cell-type resolved proton RBE model for potential clinical application
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a cell-type resolved proton relative biological effectiveness (RBE) model that accounts for variations in cellular repair capabilities. This model demonstrates improved agreement with experimental data and offers a pathway for more precise biological modeling in clinical proton therapy planning.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that approximately 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking access to local radiation oncology clinics. The findings underscore ongoing disparities in access to specialized cancer care services across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: ASTRO has issued updated clinical guidelines focusing on the implementation of shorter-course radiation therapy for patients with localized prostate cancer. These recommendations aim to provide evidence-based standards for optimized treatment delivery.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has successfully treated the first patient in the C-FLASH-01 clinical trial, which investigates the application of ConformalFLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancers. This milestone marks progress in testing the safety and clinical feasibility of ultra-high dose rate delivery in this patient population.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space for patients and caregivers
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has inaugurated a new wellness space designed to support patients and caregivers throughout their treatment journey. This development reflects the regional growth and commitment to patient-centered care within the DMV area.

articles.title: First Patient Treated in the C-FLASH-01 ConformalFLASH® Clinical Trial
articles.summary: A patient has been treated in the C-FLASH-01 trial investigating ConformalFLASH® proton therapy for head and neck cancer. This represents a significant milestone in advancing ultra-high dose rate radiation clinical research.

articles.title: BayCare opens proton therapy center at Tampa's St. Joseph’s Hospital
articles.summary: BayCare Health System has officially opened its new $33 million proton therapy center at St. Joseph's Hospital. The facility adds new proton beam capabilities to the region's existing oncology treatment infrastructure.
